_meta.description: Research-screening universe of companies and historical securities with direct, indirect, speculative or unverified AI-related business themes. Inclusion does not establish meaningful AI financial exposure or current tradability.
_meta.count_unit: security records, including historical identifiers and two Alphabet share classes; not distinct current public companies

compute_hardware.cpu_processor_ip: CPUs and processor architecture/IP; not a claim that all CPU sales are AI-specific.
compute_hardware.custom_ai_accelerators: Custom AI accelerator ASICs and associated design services, distinct from merchant GPUs.
compute_hardware.interconnect_semiconductors: Connectivity silicon, retimers, switches, DSPs and memory-interface IP; not operation of a network.
compute_hardware.semiconductor_materials: Wafer substrates, photomasks and process materials, distinguished from capital equipment.
compute_hardware.client_devices: PCs, workstations and other end-user devices with potential on-device AI functionality.
compute_hardware.test_measurement: Electronic, optical and communications test/measurement instruments and services.
compute_hardware.quantum_computing: Quantum computing hardware and associated systems/services; adjacency to AI does not establish AI commercial materiality.

infrastructure.edge_cloud_services: Content delivery, edge compute and related cloud services; not data-center real-estate ownership.
infrastructure.telecom_towers: Communications tower infrastructure; not automatically AI data-center capacity.
infrastructure.power_generation_equipment: Generators, turbines, fuel-cell systems and associated power-generation technology, not utilities.
infrastructure.energy_storage: Stationary energy-storage systems and related software/integration.
infrastructure.nuclear_reactors_services: Reactor technology, nuclear components and services, distinct from fuel production/enrichment.
infrastructure.gas_midstream: Natural-gas transport, processing and related infrastructure; indirect power-supply exposure, not an electric utility.
infrastructure.gas_production: Upstream natural-gas/associated hydrocarbon production; indirect fuel supply, not an electric utility.
infrastructure.fluid_handling: Water/industrial fluid movement, control and treatment components; AI cooling use must be separately established.

software_platform.data_platforms: Databases, data warehouses, streaming and data-management platforms; not synonymous with IT observability.
software_platform.business_intelligence: Business analytics/reporting software, distinct from market-data applications and IT observability.
software_platform.infrastructure_software: Virtualization, operating platforms and other infrastructure software, including non-SaaS licenses.
software_platform.connected_operations: Software for connected physical operations, fleet/safety/asset intelligence; not generic developer tools.

physical_ai.industrial_components: Industrial sensing, precision components and manufacturing equipment; automation adjacency does not prove substantive AI exposure.
physical_ai.on_demand_manufacturing: Digital/on-demand manufacturing services including non-additive processes, not purely 3D printing.

taxonomy_scope_clarifications.datacenter_reit_edge: Retained compatibility key now used for data-center owners/operators/colocation, including non-REITs; edge/CDN services move to edge_cloud_services.
taxonomy_scope_clarifications.gpu_accelerators: GPU acceleration; custom ASICs and processor IP are separate added leaves.
taxonomy_scope_clarifications.memory_storage: Memory/storage media, enterprise storage systems and storage-enabling products; not necessarily an AI-only product.
taxonomy_scope_clarifications.electrical_cooling_equipment: Power distribution/conversion, protection/control, HVAC/thermal equipment and relevant components. Not necessarily a pure-play cooling manufacturer.
taxonomy_scope_clarifications.enterprise_saas: Compatibility key covering enterprise applications/software; does not assert every product is sold as SaaS.
taxonomy_scope_clarifications.ai_platform_pureplay: AI-platform business role; the legacy word pureplay is not a verified company-wide revenue concentration claim.
taxonomy_scope_clarifications.consumer_internet_media: Consumer internet applications including commerce, mobility marketplaces, streaming, advertising-supported services and media.
taxonomy_scope_clarifications.hr_legal_vertical: Professional/vertical information applications including HR, legal, tax and related decision tools.
taxonomy_scope_clarifications.defense_gov: Government/defense applications and services, including civilian public-sector software.
taxonomy_scope_clarifications.autonomous_vehicles: ADAS, lidar/perception and autonomy-related vehicle systems. Inclusion does not mean unsupervised fully autonomous operation.
taxonomy_scope_clarifications.quantum: Legacy software-platform leaf retained for schema history/unweighted tags. Quantum systems records use the new compute_hardware.quantum_computing leaf.

fields.ticker: Source-supported current identifier where verified; otherwise provisional or explicitly historical. Always read security.ticker_usage/status before using it.
fields.name: Issuer name/identity reviewed against the linked sources; historical and successor names are distinguished where established.
fields.region: Quoted listing-market region, NOT issuer headquarters, domicile, revenue geography or economic-risk geography. US includes US-listed ADRs/foreign ordinary shares and historical US symbols; .T -> JP, .TW -> TW, .KS -> KR. Derived from symbol convention/identified market, not independent exchange certification.
fields.primary: Layer -> modeled thematic weight. Mechanically recomputed by summing subs through _meta.taxonomy; sums to 1.
fields.subs: Business/AI-stack role -> normalized modeled thematic weight; sums to 1 and sorted descending. Single 1.0 is categorical, not 100% AI exposure. Do not interpret as revenue, market or portfolio share.
fields.sources: Retrieved URLs with per-source scope, retrieval method and date. web_search_snippet_only is weaker than retrieved page text; some search URLs resolve to corporate homepages.
fields.security: Current/historical/uncertain instrument status. eligible_as_current_security is true only where reviewed evidence identifies the listing, false for confirmed historical identifiers, otherwise null.
fields.exposure_assessment: Qualitative AI-link assessment; unestablished financial shares are null, not fabricated estimates.
fields.weight_estimation: Weight basis, confidence, limitations and record-specific rationale.
fields.review: Every original field was inspected; records preserve before/after changes and the exact original record. Reviewed does not mean all claims verified.

weight_methodology.interpretation: Where the researched AI/business theme sits in the stack, not how much of the company is AI.
process: Use retrieved company, filing, product and corporate-action evidence to identify business roles.
Remove unsupported role labels and avoid counting the same integrated product twice by function and end market.
Use a single bucket when evidence does not justify a separate business allocation. For distinct roles, use coarse subjective proportions; exact shares remain low-confidence.
Recompute primary from subs and verify both sum to one.
Keep company-wide AI revenue and market shares null unless a defensible numerator and denominator were established; none were established here.
weight_methodology.numeric_weight_source: Reviewer judgment/convention; not company-reported AI percentages.
weight_methodology.single_bucket_warning: A utilities, semiconductor, healthcare or industrial record with 1.0 does not mean 100% of sales, value or growth is AI-related.
weight_methodology.partial_scope_warning: Non-AI operations are generally outside the thematic denominator, so this dataset cannot be used directly as a revenue-exposure or valuation model.
weight_methodology.forward_looking_warning: Development projects and prospective products must be distinguished from current commercial revenue; weights do not imply execution certainty.

review_scope.completed: Parsed and structurally checked all original records/fields; attached retrieved web evidence to every record; reviewed identities, classifications, arithmetic and identified corporate actions; documented changes and uncertainty.
not_completed_or_not_established: An exhaustive current exchange-security-master/corporate-action audit for all 443 records.
A full annual-report and revenue-segment reconciliation for every company.
Validated company-wide AI revenue percentages, market shares, price targets or expected returns.
Verification of the original claim that each company was drawn from the named ETFs.
A point-in-time frozen archive of every cited webpage; homepages and search excerpts can change.
review_scope.source_quality_warning: Most evidence is business/product/issuer overview material. The supports field defines what a link actually validates. Some sources are search snippets or limited landing pages and are explicitly qualified.
review_scope.as_of_warning: Review date is not a guarantee that every source reflects every event through that date. A publication date is provided only where established in the record/source text.
review_scope.region_migration: The original mixed HQ/listing definition was made consistent as listing-market geography. Original region values are preserved in review.original_record and must not be treated as verified HQ labels.
review_scope.historical_records: Acquired, private, delisted or unresolved legacy securities remain for traceability, rather than being silently deleted or converted to shares of their acquirers.

original_meta.description: Public companies with meaningful AI exposure, grouped by where they sit in the stack. Built from ETF holdings (BOTZ, ROBO, IRBO, AIQ, CHAT, SMH, SOXX) and known public AI-adjacent names. Not investment advice; 'AI exposure' ranges from pure-play to a small % of a diversified business.

fields.primary: stack layer -> weight (0-1, sums to 1). Derived: sum of sub weights per layer via taxonomy
fields.subs: niche -> weight (0-1, sums to 1). First key = dominant exposure
fields.region: listing / HQ region (US, CN, JP, KR, TW, EU, IL, IN, CA, SEA)

_meta.disclaimer: Research classification, not investment advice. Review issuer filings and broker/exchange instrument details before any transaction. No valuation or price recommendation is supplied.
